input.strategy_title: Rename "Data Science Projects" navigation label to "Projects"
input.strategy_markdown:
## Problem Statement

Usability testing showed the "Data Science Projects" navigation label confuses
users who arrive from OpenShift, where the same resources are called projects.
Product management approved shortening the label to "Projects" everywhere it
appears in the Dashboard UI. No behavior, routing, or API changes are involved
— this is a user-visible string change plus the corresponding documentation
touch-ups.

## High-Level Requirements

| ID | Priority | Requirement |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| HLR-1 | P2 | The Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" instead of "Data Science Projects". |
| HLR-2 | P2 | Documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old label are updated in the affected topics. |

## Affected Components

- Dashboard

## Out of Scope

- Renaming the underlying Kubernetes resources or CRDs
- Localization string review beyond the changed label

## Open Questions

None.

# Rename "Data Science Projects" navigation label to "Projects"

## Description

Shorten the user-visible "Data Science Projects" label to "Projects" everywhere it appears in the Dashboard UI — navigation entries and page headings — so the Dashboard terminology matches the OpenShift "projects" terminology users arrive with. This is a string/label change only: no behavior, routing, or API changes. The corresponding documentation touch-ups (screenshot captions and references to the old label) are folded into this epic as scope.

## Scope

- Replace the "Data Science Projects" label with "Projects" in Dashboard navigation entries and page headings.
- Update any other user-visible occurrences of the label that fall out of the same change (e.g., empty-state text, tooltips, page titles) so terminology is consistent.
- Update affected documentation topics: screenshot captions and textual references that show the old label.
- Out of scope (per strategy): renaming underlying Kubernetes resources or CRDs, and localization string review beyond the changed label.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given the Dashboard navigation, When a user views it, Then the entry previously labeled "Data Science Projects" is labeled "Projects".
- Given the projects page and any pages that previously carried a "Data Science Projects" heading, When a user views them, Then the headings read "Projects".
- Given the rest of the Dashboard UI, When the label change ships, Then no user-visible occurrence of the old "Data Science Projects" label remains in navigation or page headings.
- Given the affected documentation topics, When a reader views them, Then screenshot captions and references reflect the new "Projects" label.
- No changes to routing, URLs, API behavior, or Kubernetes resource/CRD names are introduced by this change.

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-1 (P2): Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" — covered by the UI label replacement in Scope.
- HLR-2 (P2): Documentation screenshot captions and references updated in affected topics — covered by the documentation touch-ups in Scope.
